name: dayuse-agentic-platform
description: Builds Dayuse's modular agentic architecture: portable ADK Python agents (LiteLLM, containerized), A2A orchestrators that reuse leaf agents, pluggable identity with zero cloud lock-in, GDPR and human-in-the-loop guardrails. Sits on top of the Google agents-cli skills without duplicating their generic ADK knowledge.
